P0_A_ACTUAL_INTEGRATION.json.interpretation: interface/mapping metadata only; not teacher verification, model fitting, or scientific evaluation

interface_checks.canonical_ID_mapping: static_pass: visible ID1 maps to A and ID2 maps to B; ID swap changes the candidate-to-ID map while order swap changes panel order; the pair-binding candidate order is rebuilt from the visible IDs
interface_checks.query_free_facts: static_pass: the facts builder receives no query parameter; original caption is used only for direct B and text-only C alignment; invalid facts skip C alignment
interface_checks.B_C_visual_budget: static_pass: both B and C facts receive the same rendered video list and visual note; each request has eight sampled physical frames arranged as four two-frame clips; generation caps are 256 tokens for preferences and 384 for facts
interface_checks.physical_timestamps: static_pass: display timestamps use physical_frame_id relative to video_bounds and source fps; each two-frame clip gets fps divided by its physical-frame gap; the CPU processor contract reports four grids and correct nonuniform physical time
interface_checks.sparse_supervision: static_pass_with_scope_limit: missing receipt yields zero anchors and the synthetic gradient contract restricts gradients to receipt-listed positions; P0-A source integration uses explicitly forced CPU-only receipts and records zero actual teacher-verified anchors and zero student fits
interface_checks.resource_guard: static_pass_with_caveats: launcher checks the dedicated cgroup, starts the monitor before the child, and signals only stvg-query-alignment-001.service; the design lock has no elapsed deadline

findings.detail: Parser failures are stored as parsed.status=invalid_output at lines 51-54, but the enclosing response is unconditionally written with status=accepted_actual_teacher_response at line 55. The facts control flow checks the nested status, but any downstream reader that trusts the envelope status can count malformed or truncated output as accepted.
findings.minimal_fix: Set the envelope status from parsed validity and the truncation flag, or name the field as response_generated and require downstream readers to inspect parsed.status.

findings.detail: Sampling exceptions are recorded, after which the monitor continues without stopping the owned unit. Persistent cgroup or nvidia-smi failures therefore disable the effective headroom check and can rewrite the sampling-error receipt every 250 ms.
findings.minimal_fix: Have the controller treat persistent sampling failure as loss of guard coverage and stop only the owned unit, with bounded/backed-off error reporting.

findings.detail: The monitor is started by the launcher; the worker script itself does not start or assert the monitor. Running run_stvg_query_alignment_v1.py directly bypasses the guard. The intended launch path must remain the launcher inside its dedicated service.
